basics.name: Javier Alonso
basics.label: Staff Product Designer / AI and Agentic Flows UX Lead
basics.summary: Product design leader with 20+ years of experience: 12 of them as founder and CEO of my own digital products company, and the last decade on monitoring, security and developer tools at Netdata, Sysdig, Rstor/Atrio and Docker. Product-minded and execution-focused, setting direction, aligning cross-functional teams, and translating complex technical contexts into simple, scalable workflows, driving measurable outcomes (adoption, conversion, usability) from strategy through delivery.

work.name: Docker.com
work.position: Staff Product Designer / AI and Agentic Flows UX Lead
highlights: Designed and owned Docker AI features (Model Runner, MCP Toolkit, Docker AI Agent) from early concept to shipped product; scaled MCP adoption from 0 to tens of thousands of developers within the first quarter after launch and grew the AI agent from 0 to thousands of daily active users. Improved upgrade UX (upgrade flows and in-product prompts), driving a ~19% lift in Basic → paid plan upgrades.
Redesigned Docker CLI to improve usability for millions of developers, simplifying onboarding and everyday workflows; improved CLI OAuth flows by 17%.

Served as interim PM across CLI/GUI/AI, shaping the roadmap and prioritizing UX delivery; defined the foundations of the Docker TUI (Text-based UI) and led cross-product integration of TUI features, taking it from concept to active implementation.
Built functional proof-of-concepts (beyond prototypes) combining LLM tools (Claude, v0, Lovable) with the CLI and developer workflows, accelerating validation and driving adoption in beta programs.

work.name: Metrist.io (no longer active)
highlights: Zero to one design lead at an early-stage metrics startup: built the brand identity, design system (Petal UI Kit), and first product interfaces.
Partnered with engineers (Elixir, HTML, CSS) to deliver fast iterations.
Ran customer research sessions with design partners to validate product direction.

work.name: Sysdig
work.position: Lead Product Designer & Design System Lead
highlights: Led the design of the Sysdig Secure feature for providing security and compliance monitoring for containers across the development and production lifecycle.
Migrated team from Sketch → Figma; built a scalable design system integrated with Git/Slack.
Created custom research framework with Dovetail & advanced analytics.
Trained team on research methods, increasing autonomy in testing and instrumentation.

work.name: Netdata.cloud
highlights: Owned the UX and design for both open-source and cloud products, tackling real-time data visualization at massive scale.
Defined and delivered flows that enabled developers to monitor and troubleshoot performance issues faster.
Partnered with engineering teams to ensure complex technical concepts were translated into intuitive user experiences.

work.name: Rstor / Atrio.io (spinoff, acquired by AMD)
highlights: Owned end-to-end design for all Atrio products, focused on supercomputing and HPC environments.
Designed interfaces and flows to simplify complex, large-scale infrastructure management.
Built and maintained a multi-product design system, enabling consistency and faster delivery across multiple engineering teams.
Partnered closely with RStor's technical teams in California to ensure alignment between cutting-edge HPC capabilities and usable product experiences.

work.name: Delis.io (intrapreneurship, no longer active)
highlights: A smart shopping cart in the cloud, pitched as “the Fintonic of the grocery cart”: recipes became basket orders on any device, with cheapest-supermarket comparison, allergen warnings and a revenue-share model for food publishers.
Intrapreneurship project inside Intexmedia: owned the full product specification from concept to MVP, reaching 1M unique users in its first month with no acquisition spend.
Raised the pre-seed round; the project closed when the follow-on round didn't land.

work.name: Uvalent (no longer active)
highlights: Led product as CPO for an HRM startup backed by Intexmedia (cash + tech-angel sweat equity) while the company acted as its tech provider.

work.name: Intexmedia
highlights: Hired and scaled cross-functional teams (including CTO); grew a portfolio of 44 sites to Top-10 traffic in Spain, Mexico & Argentina.
Scaled the business and recurring revenue, launching multiple SaaS MVPs aligning UX with business models.

work.name: Liqueed Studio (no longer active)
highlights: Led UX & R&D projects, including Demiko (social geolocation for Opera/Nokia) and Zentipede (project management tool) for the University of Extremadura.

agent-ux.summary: Product designer and design engineer building the interaction and trust layer for AI agents: agentic UX, sandboxes, safety patterns, MCP and local-LLM tooling. Designer who codes, shipping 0→1 developer products with measurable outcomes.

staff-lead.summary: Staff Product Designer and design leader with 15+ years in developer tools: leading 0-to-1 initiatives, design systems at org scale, and cross-functional programs from strategy through delivery, with measurable outcomes in adoption, conversion and usability.
